newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Cardoso names transport, justice ministers.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cardoso names transport, justice ministers.

text.p: President Fernando Henrique Cardoso on Friday appointed congressmen to be ministers of justice and transport, a presidential palace spokeswoman said.

She said Senator Iris Resende was named to the justice post and Deputy Eliseu Padilha was named transport minister. Both lawmakers are members of the government-allied Brazilian Democratic Movement Party (PMDB).
"They were invited to assume the posts and both accepted the invitation," she said, adding that no date had been set yet for their swearing in.
Resende, from the central Brazilian state of Goias, will fill the post vacated by Nelson Jobim, who became a justice on Brazil's highest court, the Supreme Federal Tribunal.
Padilha, from the southern state of Rio Grande do Sul, replaces Odacir Klein, who stepped down 10 months ago after his son killed a man in a hit-and-run accident.
